# First Realistic Plan — Chesed Meets Gevurah

The Awtsmoos gives without limit, yet Gevurah shapes the vessel so Awtsmoos.com remains fast, private, and true;
we index every public revelation, but never leak internal actions merely because a crawler can ask them too.

## Discovery first

1. Inventory all `_awtsmoos.derech.js` route maps and top-level static public directories.
2. Trace alias routes/templates/API helpers.
3. Trace comment/reply routes/templates/data shapes and translation fields.
4. Trace apps catalog/registry and game catalog/registry.
5. Trace root navigation and static page routing.
6. Identify publication/privacy gates for each domain.
7. Compare raw public HTML for representative routes against client-rendered meaning.

## Likely implementation families

- `geelooy/seo/` shared canonical/XML/semantic helpers.
- root sitemap index/URL set expanded to all public surface families.
- alias sitemap + alias server metadata.
- app/game sitemap based on canonical registries.
- comment SSR module loaded into post initial HTML, including public translation text and alias attribution.
- semantic crawl links from alias pages to public authored content and from posts to comments/replies only through stable anchors/routes.

No code until route/data contracts are read.
